children: Private sector house approvals in Australia rose 3.7% month-on-month to 10,885 units in August 2026, in line with flash data.
The latest result was the strongest monthly rise since July 2025,  reversing from a 1.9% decline in the previous month.
Permits grew the most in South Australia (27.7%), followed by Western Australia (8.6%), Queensland (6.5%), and Victoria (0.5%).
In contrast, approvals in New South Wales fell 4.5%.
On an annual basis, private house approvals jumped 18.4%, picking up from an 8.2% increase in July.

title: Rebound in Australia Private House Approvals Confirmed
